# Skills Index

Load the skill documents relevant to the language and framework you are working in.
All paths are relative to `.github/skills/`.

## How to Choose

```
1. Always load:         general/coding-standards/SKILL.md
2. For architecture:    general/architecture/SKILL.md
3. For PHP:             php/coding-standards/SKILL.md  +  php/architecture/SKILL.md
4. For PocketMine-MP:   pmmp/coding-standards/SKILL.md  +  pmmp/architecture/SKILL.md  +  pmmp/api/SKILL.md
5. For Java:            java/coding-standards/SKILL.md  +  java/architecture/SKILL.md
```

## Full Skill Table

| Domain | Document | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| General | `general/coding-standards/SKILL.md` | Comment policy, self-documenting code, API verification rules |
| General | `general/architecture/SKILL.md` | Language-agnostic layering, module isolation, dependency rules |
| PHP | `php/coding-standards/SKILL.md` | strict_types, use-imports, braces, types, async patterns, anti-patterns |
| PHP | `php/architecture/SKILL.md` | PHP namespace layout, autoloading, dependency injection |
| PMMP | `pmmp/coding-standards/SKILL.md` | PMMP-specific standards on top of PHP rules |
| PMMP | `pmmp/architecture/SKILL.md` | SulfurNetwork module/layer architecture |
| PMMP | `pmmp/api/SKILL.md` | PocketMine-MP 5.x verified API reference |
| Java | `java/coding-standards/SKILL.md` | Java conventions, generics, exception handling, immutability |
| Java | `java/architecture/SKILL.md` | Package layout, layered architecture, DI patterns |
